blocks.text: Nucleon number A ke muqable binding energy per nucleon ka graph banana useful (faida mand) hai. Graph par nucleus ki jagah batati hai ke nucleus kitna stable (mazboot) hai aur kya us ke fission ya fusion se energy mil sakti hai. Fig. 19.1 dikhati hai ke shuru mein hydrogen nucleus (sirf ek proton) ki binding energy zero hai. Hydrogen se helium tak graph bohat neeche girta hai; yani hydrogen ko helium mein badalne se bohat energy nikalti hai.

blocks.alt: Nucleon number A (0 se 250) ke muqable binding energy per nucleon (0 se -10 MeV, neeche ki taraf) ka graph. Curve H (0) se shuru ho kar Li aur Be se tezi se girta, Mg se guzar kar Fe ke qareeb taqreeban -8.8 MeV par sab se neeche pohanchta, phir Ag, I, Hg, Bi aur Ra se ahista uth kar 235U par taqreeban -7.6 MeV tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.1: nucleon number ke muqable average binding energy per nucleon (kitab ki Figure 19.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab binding energy ko manfi maanti hai, is liye graph 0 se -10 MeV ki taraf neeche jata hai: curve jitna neeche, nucleus utna mazbooti se bandha. Iron (Fe) ke qareeb curve sab se neeche (taqreeban -8.7 MeV) hai. Kitab ne 'Bi' ka teer A = 80 ke qareeb aur 'I' ka teer A = 150 ke qareeb chhapa hai; bismuth (Bi) ka mass number 209 aur iodine (I) ka 127 hai, is liye hum ne dono teer sahi jagah lagaye hain. Kitab ke text ka 'building energy per nucleon' asal mein binding energy per nucleon hai.

Iron ⁵⁶₂₆Fe par curve taqreeban 8.7 MeV per nucleon ki maximum (sab se zyada) value tak pohanchta hai; iron sab se stable nuclide hai. Sab se stable nuclei A = 50 aur 80 ke darmiyan hain. Us ke baad curve ke aakhir tak binding energy per nucleon aahista aahista kam hoti jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab iron ka mass number 'z6' chhapti hai; sahi ⁵⁶₂₆Fe hai.

Yani bohat halke aur bohat bhari nuclei ki binding energy per nucleon kam hoti hai. Yeh bohat ahem baat hai. Agar bhari nucleus do aise nuclei mein toote jo curve ke sab se neeche wale hisse ke qareeb hon, to woh zyada mazbooti se bandhe (stable) honge. Is process (amal) ko nuclear fission kehte hain; insaan pehle hi is se bohat zyada bijli bana raha hai.

Isi tarah curve ki halki taraf ke do nuclei agar mil kar ek nucleus ban jayen to woh zyada mazbooti se bandhe honge. Maslan deuterium aur tritium mil kar zyada stable helium nucleus banayen to bohat zyada energy nikalti hai. Lekin aisa process shuru karna aasan nahi; is ke liye bohat zyada temperature chahiye, jaisa natural taur par (khud ba khud) Sooraj aur doosre sitaron mein hai jahan fusion se bohat hi zyada energy nikalti hai. Basic rule (asal usool): jis nuclear reaction mein products ki binding energy per nucleon barh jaye, us se energy milti hai.

blocks.prompt: u wale masses istemal kar ke deuteron (²H nucleus) ki binding energy nikalein (1 u = 931.5 MeV).
blocks.explanation: Atomic masses se: Δm = m(¹H atom) + mₙ − m(²H atom) = 1.007825 + 1.008665 − 2.014102 = 0.002388 u (electrons dono taraf barabar hain). B.E = 0.002388 × 931.5 = 2.2 MeV, yani taqreeban 1.1 MeV per nucleon.

items: Mass defect Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus (19.1); B.E = (Δm)c² (19.2).
B.E per nucleon iron (⁵⁶Fe) ke qareeb sab se zyada (8.7 MeV); bhari nuclei ka fission aur halke nuclei ka fusion energy dete hain.
